text: صاحب عمل يتهم العامل بالتقصير ويسيء معاملته ويحتجز جواز سفره. السلام عليكم ورحمة الله، أعمل في مغسلة ملابس في أبوظبي بعقد عمل محدد المدة منذ شهر ٢ السابق. يقوم مدير العمل كل يوم بتشغيلي ١٠ساعات يوميًا و٥ ساعات إجازة فقط في الأسبوع ولا يعطيني أوفر تايم. تحدثت معه أكثر من مرة ليعطيني أجر وهو دائمًا يضطهدني ويلومني ويتنمر عليّ ويتحدث معي بأسلوب غير لائق وأكثر من مرة يقول أنه سيلغي العقد مما جعلني في حالة نفسية سيئة. أرسل إخطار بالفصل مدته ٣٠ يوم لي مكتوب بداخله أنني لا ألتزم بتعليمات المدير وأنني أتسبب في خسائر للشركة، وهذا كلام غير صحيح وأنا رفضت التوقيع وأرسل رسالة على الإيميل وجواز سفري معه. ما الإجراءات القانونية التي أتخذها تجاهه؟
notes: Disputes the employer's allegations in a 30-day dismissal notice. also: unpaid_wages; also: passport_withheld. Reports unpaid overtime, bullying, 10-hour workdays and only five hours off weekly; the unusual rest period is copied from the question, not corrected. Start month is relative; no year stated.

text: الحصول على قيمة وثيقة التأمين التي تغطي مستحقات العامل بعد كسب الحكم. السلام عليكم، لدي حكم عمالي ولم تقم الشركة بالسداد بعد. علمت أن الشركة اشترت وثيقة تأمين لي في أثناء عملي تغطي مكافأة نهاية الخدمة والرواتب غير المدفوعة. تقدمت بطلب للمحكمة لتخاطب شركة التأمين لتدفع لي قيمة التغطية التأمينية في حدود المبلغ المحكوم به، ولكن للأسف رفضت المحكمة ولا أدري سبب الرفض لأنني المستفيد من الوثيقة! سؤالي: كيف أُسيّل قيمة التأمين لصالحي؟
notes: Has an unpaid labour judgment and asks how to recover against an insurance policy after the court refused the request. also: gratuity; also: unpaid_wages. The immediate issue is collecting an existing judgment.

text: Terminating an employee after sick leave and claiming compensation. Hello, My employer fired me under Article 44 for not showing up for work for 7 days in a row. But that’s not the case at all. I was sick and the management was aware and they let me go. I went to another country to get treatment because it’s expensive in Dubai. My employer did not pay me my salary for the month I worked and fired me. I have official sick leave from another country and there is correspondence where my employer sent me to another country for treatment. The problem is that the employer says that he will take compensation for the training that was specified in the contract, but I did not undergo training at all; I immediately started work from the first day of work and there was no training. Does my employer have the right to charge me such a fee and not pay my salary?
notes: training repayment; asks whether the employer can recover fees for training that never occurred and withhold salary. also: unfair_termination; also: unpaid_wages. Dismissal after supported sick leave is disputed, but the final question focuses on training charges. Training fees are not identified as recruitment or visa costs.

text: Are weekends before and after leave excluded from the annual leave balance?. Hello, According to UAE labor law, is it correct that weekends before the start date and after the end date of annual leave are not counted? Example: if the leave is applied from Monday to Friday, how many days should be deducted from the annual leave balance?
notes: annual leave; asks whether weekends adjoining a Monday-to-Friday holiday count against leave. A general employee-entitlement question; the speaker does not identify their own role.

text: I filed a case for my unpaid salary and gratuity and a final decision has been released. How to enforce it?. Good day! I just want to seek advice regarding my unpaid salary and gratuity. Actually, I already filed a case in MOHRE, and they released a final decision. However, until now, my previous company has refused to give me my last salary and gratuity, and they are not even replying to my messages and emails. What should I do? Thank you
notes: Seeks enforcement of an existing final MOHRE decision after the employer refused to pay. also: unpaid_wages; also: gratuity. No amount or decision date is stated.

text: هل يمكن مقاضاة مدير الشركة والشريك في مالهم الخاص دون ذمة الشركة المالية؟. شركة ذ.م.م تم حجز حساباتها البنكية وتدعي عدم امتلاكها لأموال لتنفيذ حكم دعوى عمالية ضدها وتقدم تقارير حسابية بذلك. ولكن عند التقصي وجد أنها خاطبت عملاءها والمتعاقدين معها (مثبت بصور خطاباتها) بالسداد لها عن طريق حسابات بنكية لشركات أخرى (وسيطة). هل يمكن مقاضاة مدير الشركة والشريك في مالهم الخاص دون ذمة الشركة المالية؟
notes: Asks about collecting an existing labour judgment from the manager or partners personally after company funds were diverted to intermediary accounts. The question does not identify the speaker as the worker, a representative or another party.

text: مدة الانتظار لإيداع الحكم بالتنفيذ. السلام عليكم، تقدمت بشكوى عمالية وتم إحالتها للقضاء. صدر الحكم فيها حكمًا قطعيًا لصالحي خاصة أن مبلغ المستحقات أقل من النصاب القانوني. أولاً: ما المدة التي يتوجب علي انتظارها لإيداع الحكم بالتنفيذ؟ علمًا بأن الحكم قطعي بتاريخ 20-09-2022؟ ثانيًا: ما الإجراء المطلوب للالتحاق بمكان عمل جديد (عمل إقامة جديدة)؟
notes: Asks when a final labour judgment can be submitted for execution. also: other (new employment and residence procedures). The explicit judgment date is retained; no award amount is given.

text: Requesting an employee to provide a new offer letter to release their passport. Hello, My employer is unwilling to return my passport, saying he needs a new offer letter from a different company to release it. Could you please advise what action can be taken to address this?
notes: Employer refuses to return the passport without an offer letter from a new employer. The requested action concerns release of the passport.

text: إلزام صاحب العمل بدفع مستحقات الموظف المحكوم له بها. أعمل في شركة تطوير مشروعات بالإمارات منذ 5 سنوات، وتعمل على تطوير مشروع كبير لصالح إحدى الدول. منذ العام الثالث بدأ تأخير راتبي وأصبح صاحب العمل يدفع لي أجزاء من راتبي كل شهر دفعات نقدية. ولكنه انقطع عن الدفع تماماً طيلة الأشهر الست الأخيرة. وتبقى مجموع مستحقاتي المتأخرة ما يقرب من راتب سنتين 700.000 درهم تقريباً بدون نهاية الخدمة وباقي المستحقات. قدمت شكوى للعمل منذ شهرين وطلب مني مهلة شهر حتى يتمكن من السداد ووافقت على إعطائه المهلة. ولكنه لم يفِ بوعده للمرة المئة. سؤالي: ماذا يكون الإجراء حسب القانون إذا حكمت لي المحكمة بمستحقاتي ولكنه لا يستطيع دفعها ؟ هل هناك قضايا مشابهة يمكن أن نفهم منها ؟ وشكراً مقدماً
notes: Asks how an award could be collected if the employer cannot pay; a labour complaint has already been filed. also: unpaid_wages; also: gratuity. About two years' salary is outstanding, with no payment for the last six months. The question asks hypothetically about a court ruling; the title alone is not proof a judgment already exists. Amount is approximate and excludes gratuity and other dues.

text: الإبلاغ عن خادمة تركت العمل في السعودية وذهبت إلى الإمارات. السلام عليكم، لدي خادمة فلبينية وأنا من المملكة العربية السعودية. حجزت لها رحلة إلى مانيلا، ولكن تفاجأت أنها حجزت من مالها إلى الإمارات ووصولت وأرسلت لي أنها ستعمل هناك. هل يجب أن تُبلَّغ دولة الإمارات؟ وما الإجراءات؟
notes: domestic worker; reporting a maid who left a Saudi employer and travelled to the UAE instead of Manila. Asker explicitly employs the maid. Cross-border employment and reporting issue; no wage or passport claim is stated.

text: Can my old employer sue me for a non-compete clause that's only in the offer letter?. Hi, I was previously working in a company based in DMCC and have now moved to Hamriyah Free Zone. In my DMCC contract, there was no mention of a non-compete, but my offer letter includes one. Now, in my new organization, if my old customers start to contact me for business, am I liable for any legal action from my previous employer?
notes: non-compete; asks whether a restriction in an offer letter, absent from the DMCC contract, can be enforced after moving to Hamriyah Free Zone. DMCC and the free zone are jurisdictions, not employer names.

text: هل توجد إجازة مرضية مدفوعة الأجر خلال شهر الإنذار؟. السلام عليكم ورحمة الله، هل توجد إجازة مرضية مدفوعة الأجر خلال شهر الإنذار؟ علمت أن صاحب العمل هو مَن أنهى العمل
notes: sick leave during notice; asks about paid medical leave when the employer has ended employment. No claim that salary was withheld or dismissal was unjustified; speaker's role is not explicit.

text: I resigned before completing 1 year. Am I still eligible for leave salary and gratuity?. Dear Lawyers, I resigned before completing 1 year, but with a 90-day notice, I completed 1 year and 27 days. Am I still eligible for leave salary and gratuity?
notes: annual leave pay; asks about leave salary and gratuity eligibility after resignation, including the 90-day notice period. also: gratuity. Leave salary is mentioned first and no non-payment is alleged, so the equal-issue tie is assigned to other. Duration includes notice.

text: What can I do if my company delays my salary more than ten days?. Good day, In my contract, salary payment days are around the 30th of each month. My company delays salary payment. Now the first month, it's been 10-15 days, and until the moment I haven’t received my salary for May. Is it legal? Which legal argument I can use in this case? Thank you
notes: Salary for May remains unpaid 10-15 days after its expected payment date. The year and salary amount are not stated; the contractual payday is around the 30th.

text: كيف يمكن الحجز على ممتلكات الشركة بعد تغيير الشركاء لأخذ المستحقات العمالية؟. لدي حكم قضائي بمستحقاتي لدي شركة مقاولات كنت أعمل بها وهي قامت بتغيير اسمها التجاري وتغيير الشركاء ولكن لا يزال لديها مشاريع تحت اسمها السابق وتصرف لهم دفعات. فهل يمكنني الحجز على الأموال التي تصرف لهم؟ لأنني تقدمت لدى محكمة التنفيذ بالحجز على أرصدة البنوك والحجز على الرخصة التجارية ولكن دون جدوى
notes: Has a labour judgment and asks to attach company receivables after changes to the trade name and partners. Previous attempts to seize bank funds and the trade licence were unsuccessful.

text: Can an employee be absent on sick leave during the notice period?. I would like to confirm whether an employee is legally permitted to be absent from work during the notice period if the absence is due to a legitimate medical condition and supported by an approved medical certificate
notes: sick leave during notice; asks whether approved medical absence is permitted during a notice period. Generic wording does not establish whether the asker is the employee or employer.

text: الاستقالة خلال فترة التجربة والبحث عن عمل آخر. مرحبا أعمل عامل بناء في شركة مقاولات. مضى علي شهر واحد في فترة التجربة ولم تصدر الإقامة بعد في عقد غير محدد وأريد الاستقـالة نظراً لإصابتي بداء السكري لأن العمل شاق جداً؛ 11ساعه ف اليوم. كيف أستطيع الاستقالة والبحث عن عمل آخر؟ ســاعدني وجزاك الله خير
notes: resignation during probation; construction worker wants to leave because diabetes makes 11-hour workdays difficult and residence processing is incomplete. No year is provided; an unlimited contract alone does not establish events pre2022.

text: استئناف صدر صالح عامل بسبب خطأ في احتساب الرواتب المستحقة. السلام عليكم، رفع عامل قضية عمالية واليوم صدر الحكم لصالحه بمبلغ. كانت طلباته أنه لم يحصل على راتب أقل من شهرين مع العلم أنه تم إيداع الراتب الأخير له بالحساب وله فقط نصف شهر ومع ذلك حكم القاضي بثلاثة أشهر راتب وهذا غير صحيح. هل يجب الطعن أو الاستئناف على الحكم وأن هناك خطأ في إعطائه ثلاثة أشهر وهو له نصف شهر فقط؟
notes: Employer-side challenge to a labour award: claims the employee was owed half a month's salary but was awarded three months. Asks whether to appeal or challenge the calculation; no currency amount is stated.

text: تحصيل مستحقات عمالية من شركة مغلقة. السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، لدي حكم عمالي منذ قرابة العام والشركة مغلقة. قدمت طلبًا للحجز لدى عدد من البنوك والممتلكات، ولكن ليس لدى الشركة أي ممتلكات. كما تقدمت بطلب ضبط وإحضار تم رفضه لأن الشركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة والمدير شخصية منفصلة. كيف يمكن لي تحصيل المبلغ؟ شكرًا لكم!
notes: Seeks recovery of a year-old labour judgment against a closed LLC with no identified assets; attachment and arrest requests have failed. The year relates to the judgment, not employment duration.

text: After securing an executive judgment for unpaid salary and final settlement, what's next?. Dear Sir/Madam, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to follow up on the matter of my unpaid salary and final settlement, amounting to 49,000, for which I have already obtained an executive judgment. Despite this, I have not yet received the payment. Could you please advise on the next steps to proceed with the issuance of an arrest warrant or any other necessary actions to ensure the recovery of my dues?
notes: Has an executable judgment for unpaid salary and final settlement and asks about an arrest warrant or other collection steps. also: unpaid_wages. The amount has no stated currency; none has been added.

text: إنهاء عقد العمل بدون إنذار. أنهى صاحب العمل عقدي وأنا مدوام في العمل بدون إنذاري وبدون توقيعي. ماذا أفعل؟
notes: Employer terminated the contract while the worker was attending work, without notice or the worker's signature. Asks what to do about the dismissal.

text: Can I pass in the UAE transit area if I left Dubai without proper visa cancellation?. Good afternoon, I hold a valid UAE employee visa (issued in Dubai). I have not been to the UAE for over 6 months. I am currently attempting to cancel the visa through MOHRE, as the owner of the company has left the country and has not been responsive. Additionally, the trade license has expired. Is it possible for me to be in transit in the UAE, specifically within the airport's transit zone? Can I seek employment in Qatar before my UAE visa is canceled? I prefer to avoid unnecessary expenditures of time and money and can't be more unemployed. Thank you
notes: visa cancellation and airport transit; former employee has been outside the UAE for over six months and asks about transit and a job in Qatar. Employer is unresponsive and the trade licence has expired. Time outside the country is not employment duration.

text: Can someone with a drink-and-drive case in the UAE switch jobs after termination?. Hello everyone. I want to ask: my friend has a drink-and-drive case in the UAE and has been terminated from his company. Can he join another company, or is it possible for him to change jobs? Please advise. Thank you!
notes: job change after criminal case; asks on behalf of a friend with a drink-driving case who was dismissed. The issue is eligibility to join another employer, not a claim of unfair dismissal; asker is a third party.

text: هل عند انتهاء عقد العمل محدد المدة يطالب صاحب العمل بشهر إنذار؟. السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، هل عند انتهاء عقد العمل محدد المدة يطالبني صاحب العمل بشهر إنذار؟
notes: notice period at fixed-term contract expiry; asks whether the employer can require one month's notice when the contract ends. Contract length and employment duration are not given.

text: مَن يتحمل تكاليف الإقامة في حالة استقالة العامل قبل انتهاء عقد العمل؟. السلام عليكم، تحية طيبة وبعد، كما هو معلوم فإن قانون العمل الجديد رقم 33 جعل جميع عقود العمل محددة المدة، ولدينا الأسئلة التالية: 1. مَن يتحمل تكاليف الإقامة في حالة استقالة العامل قبل انتهاء عقد العمل؟ 2. إذا كان قانون العمل يتيح لصاحب العمل تحميل العامل تكاليف الإقامة في حال استقال قبل انتهاء عقد العمل، فهل يمكن لصاحب العمل وضع شرط جزائي في عقد العمل ينص على تحميل العامل تكاليف الإقامة عند الاستقالة قبل تاريخ انتهاء العقد؟ وما الحد الأعلى للشرط الجزائي؟
notes: Asks who bears residence-visa costs if a worker resigns early and whether an employer can impose a contractual penalty for them. Employer-oriented drafting question, but the speaker does not explicitly identify their role. Reference to Law 33 is not an event date.

text: إنهاء عقد عمل غير محدد المدة بدون إنذار وتوقيع الموظف على خطاب الفصل. السلام عليكم، أنهى صاحب العمل عقدي بعد استدعائي إلى مكتبه. عملت مع المستشفي ١١ شهرًا لا يوجد فيها أي شكوى أو إنذار. طلبت صورة من خطاب الفصل، ولكن طُلِب مني التوقيع أولاً فوقعت حتى أتمكن من تقديم الشكوى بمكتب العمل. صاحب العمل يقول: بما أني وقعت على خطاب الفصل والذي نصه "بناءً على الميل الذي أرسلته، قامت الإدارة بفصلك من العمل"، فإن هذا دليل على موافقتي. ما الرد على هذا؟ شكرًا لكم!
notes: Disputes dismissal without notice and whether signing the dismissal letter proves consent. No previous warnings or complaints are reported. An unlimited contract does not by itself establish the year of events.

text: How are sick leaves counted if taken before public holidays or weekends?. Dear Sir/Madam, How are sick leaves counted if an employee takes sick leave before public holidays or weekends?
notes: sick leave calculation; asks how medical leave is counted when it precedes weekends or public holidays. No unpaid salary is alleged and the speaker's role is not stated.

text: Can I leave my job for a better offer without paying the penalty in my offer letter?. Hello Lawyers, I signed an offer when I joined this company stating that if I resign before two years, I will have to pay them 5,000 dirhams. I am now 9 months in and have found a better job. Can I walk out freely without paying anything?
notes: resignation penalty; asks about leaving for a better job despite a payment clause for resignation before two years. The purpose of the charge is not stated, so it is not assumed to be recruitment or training fees. Two years is the clause period, not service completed.

text: هل يحق للعامل تذكرة طيران سنوية عند أخذ إجازة؟. السلام عليكم، هل يحق للعامل تذكرة طيران سنوية عند أخذ إجازة؟ وهل يجب تقديم استقالة؟
notes: annual flight entitlement; asks whether a worker receives a yearly ticket with leave and whether resignation is required. No specific employer refusal or unpaid allowance is alleged; asker role is not explicit.

text: Should health insurance for an Emirati employee cover her children or just her?. Hello, Do we need to provide health insurance for our Emirati employee, who earns AED 4,000/month, and should it cover only her, or do we need to include coverage for her children as well? She is married with six children, but we would like to ensure that the health insurance is for her only. Thank you for your clarification!
notes: dependent health insurance; employer asks whether an Emirati employee's children must be covered. Amount is the quoted employee salary, not a disputed insurance bill. Six children is family information, not service duration.

text: تأخير الرواتب والاقتطاع منها دون موافقة الموظف. تحية طيبة، أعمل في شركة مقاولات وهي غير منتظمة بدفع الرواتب بتاتًا حيث إننا بالشركة نعاني مما يلي: ١- يدفعون الراتب كل ٤٥ إلى ٥٠ يومًا وأحيانًا تصل المدة بين الراتب والآخر إلى ٦٠ يومًا وأحيانًا يدفعون لنا نصف راتب فقط. ٢- منذ بداية عام ٢٠١٩، تم اقتطاع مبلغ ٣٠٠٠ درهم من الراتب دون موافقتي وإلى تاريخه يتم اقتطاع هذا المبلغ شهريًا من راتبي. ٣- هناك راتبين لشهري يوليو وأكتوبر ٢٠١٨ لم أستلمهما ورواتب ٥ أشهر لعام ٢٠١٩ إضافة إلى رواتبي حتى تاريخ هذا الاستفسار حيث إن مجموع الرواتب المستحقة يصل إلى ١٠ رواتب هذا غير الإجازات السنوية. أرجو الإفادة بما يجب علي فعله. كيف أستطيع تحصيل حقوقي من هذه الشركة؟ هل أستطيع المطالبة بالرواتب المتأخرة منذ عام ٢٠١٨؟ وكيف ذلك؟ مع العلم أن عقد العمل الخاص بي غير محدد المدة ولكن لم يتم تجديده من قبل الشركة منذ شهر مارس ٢٠١٩. ولكم جزيل الشكر!
notes: events pre2022; reports salaries paid every 45-60 days, partial payments and monthly deductions of ٣٠٠٠ درهم from 2019. Unpaid July and October 2018 wages plus 2019 and later arrears total ten salaries. Contract was not renewed after March 2019. also: other (annual leave dues). Amount is the monthly deduction, not a total arrears calculation.

text: Am I eligible for leave salary after one year of service if I resign with the required notice?. Dear Lawyers, After completing one year of service, am I eligible for leave salary if I resign with the required notice period? What are my rights if the company does not pay or delays the cancellation of my visa, as I am joining another company?
notes: annual leave pay after resignation; asks about entitlement after completing a year and giving notice. Also asks hypothetically about withheld dues and delayed visa cancellation; no actual non-payment is established. No specific gratuity question is made.

text: كيفية التأكد من صحة عرض عمل في دبي. لقد تلقيت عرض عمل من دبي وطلبوا إرسال النسخة موقعة إلى الشركة وأيضاً إلى شركة سفر وسياحة. كيف أتأكد إذا كان صحيح؟
notes: job-offer authenticity; prospective worker wants to verify a Dubai offer requiring a signed copy to the company and a travel agency. No fee request or payment is stated, so recruitment_fees would be speculative.

text: هل تلغي المحكمة العمالية الإقامة وبطاقة العمل تلقائيًا بعد صدور الحكم؟. السلام عليكم، تقدمت بشكوى عمالية ضد الشركة وقد صدر الحكم واستلمت كافة حقوقي. هل تلغي المحكمة إقامتي وبطاقة العمل أم أنه يجب عليّ التقدُّم بطلب الإلغاء؟ ومَن يتحمل مصاريف الإلغاء؟ وشكرًا!
notes: visa and labour-card cancellation after judgment; all awarded dues have already been received. Asks whether cancellation is automatic and who pays. Not an enforcement dispute or a question about a charge being passed to the worker.

text: هل يجب دفع مبلغ قبل المجيء للعمل في دولة الإمارات؟. السلام عليكم، هل يجب دفع مبلغ قبل المجيء للعمل في دولة الإمارات؟ أنا من سلطنة عمان واستلمت عقد عمل
notes: Prospective worker from Oman asks whether payment is required before coming to work in the UAE after receiving a contract. The question concerns an upfront hiring payment; its recipient and amount are not stated.

text: حصول العامل على أجره المتأخر بعد براءته من تهمة خيانة الأمانة. رفعت قضية عمالية ضد الشركة أطالب فيها بالأجور المتأخرة عن 21 شهر حيث تم توقيفي ومنعي من العمل ورفعوا قضية خيانة أمانة ضدي وأخذت براءة والحمد الله. هل ستحكم لي المحكمة بكامل أجري المتأخر؟
notes: Pending labour case seeks 21 months of wages after acquittal on a breach-of-trust charge and suspension from work. Asks what the court will award. also: unpaid_wages. The 21 months describe the wage claim, not confirmed total service.

text: هل يستطيع صاحب العمل أن يضر العامل إذا كان جواز السفر بحوزته؟. السلام عليكم، حصلت على عرض عمل براتب أكبر من الحالي وأرسلته للكفيل بالواتس وأحضرته معي بالشركة والكاميرات سجلت كل شيء. رفض توقيعه بالقبول أو الرفض وأخبرني أنه يريد نصف تكاليف الإقامة التي دفعها من قبل حيث دفعت أنا نصف تكاليف الإقامة فقط وهو دفع النصف الآخر. يحاول الآن إرضائي كي لا أتركه برفع راتبي الحالي، وقد أظهر لي سماحة في التعامل حتى فاتني عرض العمل الذي حصلت عليه. بعد أيام طلب مني الاحتفاظ بجواز السفر معه، فهل يستطيع إلحاق الضرر بي حين يكون معه جواز السفر الخاص بي أو يستطيع التعميم علي في أي وقت؟ الزملاء بالشركة يؤكدون أنه غدر بأكثر من شخص كان يعمل معهم عندما شعر منهم بالرغبة في ترك العمل والذهاب لغيره
notes: passport retention and absconding-report risk; employer requested the passport after blocking a move to a better job. also: recruitment_fees (worker paid half the residence costs and employer demands the balance). Final question concerns harm if the passport is held; actual handover or refusal to return it is not explicit, so passport_withheld is the nearest topic with that uncertainty preserved.

text: المستندات الواجب إرسالها للموظف خلال فترة الإشعار. السلام عليكم، الاستشارة القانونية ثم التمثيل المطلوب من محام متخصص في قانون العمل. شكرًا لكم!
notes: notice-period documents / request for legal representation; title mentions documents to send during notice, but the body only requests a labour lawyer. Insufficient facts to identify a dispute, asker role or any substantive entitlement.

text: تحويل العقد من عقد غير محدد المدة إلى عقد محدد المدة رغم رفض العامل. ما مدى صحة تحويل عقد العمل من عقد غير محدد المدة إلى عقد جديد يلغي كل ما قبله بمدة محددة؟ مع تهديد صاحب العمل بأن من لا يرغب في التوقيع على العقود الجديدة قد تُنهَى خدماته. وهل يجوز فسخ عقد العمل الموقَّع قبل بدء سريان تاريخه من قبل العامل؟
notes: contract conversion and resignation; asks about replacing an unlimited contract with a fixed-term contract under threat of dismissal, and ending the signed contract before its start date. No completed dismissal is alleged. Year is not stated.

text: I was convicted in a case and served a sentence. Can I get a police clearance certificate to join a job?. Respected member, I have a 2-year-old case where I was convicted (I completed a sentence of 1 month in prison for a 1st-degree misdemeanor; breach of trust). I am now in the process of getting a rehabilitation certificate from Dubai. I have a new job offer in Abu Dhabi, and HR will ask me to obtain a police clearance certificate from the MOI. If I get the rehabilitation certificate from Dubai, will it also clear my name in MOI? Also, can I get a certificate from them?
notes: police clearance and rehabilitation for a new job; asks whether a Dubai rehabilitation certificate clears a past conviction in MOI records. A two-year-old criminal case and one-month sentence are not employment duration; no event year is stated.

text: الموقف القانوني لموظف استلم الأموال من المستثمرين عندما يطالبون بها. السلام عليكم، عملت زوجتي بشركة لمدة شهرين وصاحب الشركة خارج الدولة وما زال ولم يتم الإجراءات القانونية كموافقة العمل لأنها على كفالتي. وعد بالحضور للدولة ولم يأتِ فتركت زوجتي العمل معهم. خلال فترة الشهرين كانت تستلم أموال من مستثمرين مع الشركة وتحرر إيصالات استلام خاصة بالشركة. صاحب الشركة لم يُسلِّم الأرباح للمستثمرين وهم الآن يسعون خلفه ويتصلون بزوجتي ويقولون أنها استلمت أموالهم ويطالبونها بالضغط على صاحب الشركة لإرجاع أموالهم. ما موقف زوجتي القانوني هنا؟
notes: criminal/civil liability for investor receipts; husband asks about his wife's liability after collecting money for an absent company owner without a work permit. The duration describes the wife's employment, not the asker's. Investor profits, rather than wages, are at issue.

text: التوقيع على الاستقالة قبل الحصول على المستحقات. السلام عليكم، لقد اضطررت لتوقيع استقالتي قبل أخذ مستحقاتي. هل يمنعني ذلك من المطالبة بمستحقاتي طبقًا لقانون العمل الإماراتي؟ علمًا بأن عقدي محدد المدة ولم يتم إخطاري كتابة
notes: resignation and settlement rights; asks whether a signed resignation prevents later claims for unspecified employment dues. also: unfair_termination (possible pressure and lack of written notice, but dismissal is not explicit). No wage/gratuity breakdown is supplied, so a more specific dues label is not inferred.

text: I finished all execution steps. How to prevent the employer from lifting travel ban until paying my dues?. My labor implementation case is currently in progress. Despite taking several steps, such as inquiring about the bank account and blocking the traffic file, my employer has not responded and disregarded the court's decision. As a result, I requested a travel ban, and the court accepted my request. Now, the employer is actively working to lift the travel ban. He has submitted six requests to the court for its cancellation, arguing that he is a local, the company is an LLC, and he comes from a reputed family. He also stated that the highest court had declared the travel ban to be a violation of human rights and that the non-payment was due to the company’s financial losses, not the manager’s fault. However, the court rejected his request. The employer has now filed a grievance with the Execution Circuit for the Court Head. Could you advise me if there is anything I need to do? Should I just patiently wait to see how the court proceeds with the case against the company manager?
notes: Existing execution case with a travel ban against the employer; asks how to respond to attempts to lift it before payment. Focus is execution-court procedure, not the worker's own immigration status.

text: مستحقات الموظف عند توقفه عن العمل بسبب حادث سيارة. السلام عليكم، أعمل لدى شركة منذ 4 سنوات وأتقاضى راتبًا إجماليًا قدره 4 آلاف درهم والراتب الأساسي 2400 درهم ولي مستحقات بدل إجازة من تاريخ 13/06/2019 حتى 31/01/2022. نتيجة حادث سيارة في أثناء وقت العمل، توقفت عن العمل من الفترة 27/12/2021 إلى 31/01/2022. استفساري بخصوص الآتي: 1- بدل الإجازة المستحق. 2- نهاية الخدمة. 3- المستحق لي من فترة إصابة حادث السيارة
notes: events pre2022; annual leave pay is the first of three entitlement questions. also: gratuity; also: other (work injury compensation). Gross salary is 4 آلاف درهم and basic salary is 2400 درهم. Unused leave covers 13/06/2019 to 31/01/2022; accident-related absence runs 27/12/2021 to 31/01/2022. No non-payment is explicitly alleged; total claim is not calculated.

text: Calculating leave for an employee with unused days after termination. Hi, How to calculate leave if an employee has already ended her contract but has 30 days of leave that she did not use?
notes: unused annual leave payout; asks how to calculate payment for 30 unused days after contract end. No allegation of withheld salary and no explicit asker role; 30 days is leave balance, not employment duration.

text: مغادرة البلاد دون تسوية قرض بنكي واحتمال المنع من السفر. تركت العمل بدبي وستُلغَى إقامتي من جهة العمل وسأغادر الإمارات لكن لا يزال مستحق عليّ قرض بنكي بقيمة 12000 درهم. المبلغ غير متوفر وسأضطر إلى المغادرة دون السداد وسأسدد من مصر لاحقًا. سؤالي: هل سأُمنَع من السفر في المطار لوجود قرض مع العلم أنني أنوي السداد خلال 3 أشهر على الأكثر إن شاء الله؟ لا توجد عليّ متأخرات أو عدم انتظام في السداد أو تخلف عن الدفع. شكرًا للمساعدة!
notes: bank loan and travel ban; former worker plans to leave before repaying an otherwise current loan and asks about an airport travel restriction. The intended three-month repayment period is not employment duration.

text: هل يمكن العمل بتأشيرة زيارة لحين إصدار تأشيرة وتصريح عمل؟. السلام عليكم، أعمل في شركة في دبي ووقّعت على عرض عمل منذ شهر. الآن الشركة تريد تجديد تأشيرة زيارتي فقط. هل يلحقني أي ضرر إذا أتى قسم التفتيش إلى الشركة إذا لم يكن لي ملف جاري في مكتب الهجرة ووزارة العمل؟ كل الاحترام!
notes: working on a visit visa; asks about inspection consequences when the company renews a visit visa rather than arranging work authorisation. Offer letter was signed a month ago, which does not establish total service.

text: I have a Labour case against the company and they cannot find them on the registered address. What to do?. I have a labor case against the company; it's a small company working from home. After MOHRE, I filed it in the court. 3 hearings are over already, and the other party has not shown up at any hearings and has not responded to any court notifications. They are not coming to the registered address, so the court has not been able to serve them properly either. The trade license is active, and the company is working, putting updates on LinkedIn and all that. How many more hearings might the court give before giving judgment? What can be done from my side?
notes: Active labour case has had three hearings without effective service on the employer. Asks about further hearings, judgment timing and steps to address non-service; no award exists yet.

text: المطالبة بالمستحقات لدى مجموعة شركات لنفس المالك. السلام عليكم، الرجاء المساعدة لرفع قضية عمالية! عملت في جروب لمجموعة من الشركات لمدة ٧ سنوات ونُقلت للعمل في شركة لمدة سنتين، ثم نُقلت بعدها لشركة أخرى في المجموعة لمدة سنتين ومن ثم نُقلت للشركة الأخيرة وعملت فيها لمدة ٣ سنوات وتُسدَّد مستحقاتي عند نقلي من شركة لشركة أخرى، مع العلم أن جميع الشركات لنفس المالك. هل لي الحق في المطالبة بالإجازات ونهاية الخدمة لدى جميع الشركات أم لدى آخر شركة عملت بها؟ عندي رواتب متأخرة لأكثر من ٦ أشهر. كيف يمكنني معرفة الرواتب المتأخرة لأن الشركة تدفع جزء من الراتب وليس كامل الراتب؟ عند الدخول إلى حماية الأجور، لم أجد الرواتب إلا لمدة ٦ أشهر مع العلم أنه لدي رواتب وأجزاء رواتب منذ عام ٢٠٢٠. ولكم جزيل الشكر!
notes: events pre2022 (arrears since 2020; later event dates unknown); Main practical issue is recovering and identifying unpaid or partial wages outstanding for over six months, including arrears since 2020. also: gratuity; also: other (leave entitlement and liability across group companies). Seven years across the group comprise two, two and three years at successive companies; duration field records the last company. Prior transfers reportedly included settlement of dues. Arrears begin in 2020, but the question's overall date is unknown.

text: الخروج من شركة متعثرة رغم رفض الشركاء. السلام عليكم، أنا مدير وشريك بنسبة ٢٠% في شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة . الشركة متعثرة ماليًا بسبب عدم تحصيل مستحقاتها ووجود أحكام قضائية ضدها وشيكات مرتجعة. الشركاء يرفضون عزلي على الرغم من تقديم استقالتي ويرفضون إفلاسها. ما المسؤولية القانونية؟ وكيف أخرج من الشركة بدون عواقب قانونية؟
notes: company-partner exit and manager liability; a 20% shareholder-manager wants to resign from an insolvent LLC despite partner opposition. Not asking about an employee, so employer role is not inferred solely from ownership. Existing judgments and bounced cheques are not identified as labour claims.

text: الإجراء القانوني ضد شركة تؤخر دفع الرواتب. أنا مهندس مدني أعمل في شركة مقاولات. الشركة تدفع الرواتب متأخرًا بمعدل 4 شهور؛ فهي تدفع الرواتب شهريًا، ولكن بتأخير 4 شهور. بمعنى نحن في شهر 2 ننتظر راتب شهر 10. ما حقوقي؟ وما كيفية تحصيلها بالقانون؟
notes: Company pays wages four months late; in month 2 workers are waiting for month 10 pay. Asks how to recover wages. Month and year are not converted to calendar dates or assigned an unstated year.

text: If fired with a 3-month notice, will apartment and car fees be covered during that period?. Dear Lawyers, If I get fired and have a 3-month notice period, with apartment, school, and car fees paid by the company, do I continue to receive those benefits during the 3-month notice period?
notes: notice-period benefits; asks whether employer-paid apartment, school and car costs continue through a hypothetical three-month dismissal notice. No actual withholding is alleged and no amount is supplied.

text: حقوق العامل عند إنهاء عقد العمل محدد المدة بدون سبب. سيدي العزيز، أنهت الشركة عقد العمل الخاص بي مؤخرًا حيث عملت معهم لمدة عام و6 أشهر بموجب عقد محدد المدة. كنت أعمل في مجموع 6 شركات؛ 4 منها تابعة لصاحب العمل واثنتين لزوجته وبنته (عقد العمل لشركة واحدة فقط). عندي أكثر من 14 إيميل شكر من صاحب العمل، وتم إنهاء عقد العمل بشكل مفاجئ بسبب خلاف شخصي بتاريخ 15/09/2019. الراتب 14.000 درهم. أردت أن أعرف إذا كنت أستحق الحصول على تعويض عن فسخ العقد محدد المدة + الفصل التعسفي. مع الشكر والتقدير!
notes: events pre2022; fixed-term employment ended abruptly after a personal disagreement despite positive feedback. Asks for early-termination and arbitrary-dismissal compensation. Worked across six related businesses under one employment contract; no employer name is stated. Amount is quoted salary, not a calculated award.

text: What is the responsibility of the employee in case of leaving before the end of the notice period?. What is the responsibility of the employee? The employment contract is set to conclude on 31st May 2025. The employee initiated discussions regarding a salary increment approximately 30 days prior, during which the management engaged in meetings with the employee but ultimately decided to maintain the current salary. The employee subsequently chose not to renew or continue the employment, this decision having been finalized in a meeting held on 20th May 2025. How does the notice period apply in this context? Specifically: 1) Would the grace period (30 days after the contract/visa ends) be considered as fulfilling the notice period requirement? 2) Is the employee entitled to request a different salary during this grace or notice period?
notes: notice period at non-renewal; decision not to continue was made on 20th May 2025 before contract end on 31st May 2025. Asks whether immigration grace time counts as notice and whether salary can change. Third-person narrative could be employer-side, but speaker role is not explicit.

text: تقديم بلاغ هروب من الكفيل رغم عدم توقيع العامل على عرض أو عقد العمل. السلام عليكم، كيف أستطيع رفع بلاغ هروب من جوزات العين قدمه الكفيل مع العلم أني لم أوقع على عرض العمل ولا عقد العمل فكيف نقل الكفيل الكفالة إليه وأنا لم أوقع معه أي عقد؟! أرجو منكم مساعدتي فأنا منذ شهر ولم أستطع حل المشكلة!
notes: absconding report and sponsorship transfer; worker wants to remove a sponsor's report despite never signing an offer or employment contract. A month spent trying to resolve the issue is not length of employment.

text: Can a MOHRE non-payment certificate help transfer my UAE visa before a court case is filed?. Hello, Is the following correct regarding transferring the UAE visa? The non-payment certificate issued by MOHRE can allow you to transfer your visa in the UAE, even if your case has not yet been registered in court. Here’s how it works: Non-Payment Certificate from MOHRE: - What It Is: The non-payment certificate from MOHRE confirms that your employer has failed to pay your wages or commissions, which is considered a violation of labor laws. - Importance: This certificate serves as proof that your employer is not fulfilling their obligations and supports your case for a visa transfer to a new employer. - MOHRE’s Role: MOHRE issues this certificate based on its mediation process with your employer. If your employer is uncooperative, refuses to pay, or fails to respond to MOHRE’s attempts to resolve the issue, MOHRE will issue the certificate
notes: visa transfer and MOHRE non-payment certificate; asks whether a quoted explanation about transfer before court registration is correct. also: unpaid_wages (background of the quoted scenario). No personal case or asker role is established; statements in the quotation are not treated as verified legal rules.

text: Can the employer ask to access the personal data of his employees?. Can the employer ask the employee to submit or give access to the employee's personal accounts like LinkedIn, Facebook, and his personal laptop, personal phone, etc. upon the termination of his employment? Which law applies to this in the UAE?
notes: employee privacy; asks whether employers may demand access to personal social-media accounts, laptops and phones at termination. Generic question does not identify the asker as employer or worker; no retention of official identity documents is alleged.

text: Employer cancelled my job after signing offer letter and contract. What are my rights?. Hello, After signing the offer letter and labor contract, my employer suddenly emailed me saying they will not continue my job and will cancel my work permit due to some internal policy
notes: Employer cancelled the job and proposed work-permit cancellation after both offer and labour contract were signed, citing internal policy. Employment start date and whether work actually began are not stated.

text: How can an employee who is mistreated get deported back home?. Good day, I have a sister who is African, and she got a job at a ranch. They made her sign a form stating that she received a loan from the employer. Now, she is being mistreated, overworked, and underpaid. They are threatening that she can't leave and will never be allowed to until her contract is finished. She does not have any money to repay the loan or even pay for her flights back home. Is there a way that she can be deported back home?
notes: repatriation and coercive employment; sibling asks how a mistreated ranch worker can return home despite an alleged loan and threats preventing departure. also: unpaid_wages (underpayment). Ranch employment does not establish household domestic-worker status; loan is not identified as recruitment fees and no passport retention is stated.

text: اتهام موظف بالاختلاس بعد الاستقالة وتسليم العهدة. السلام عليكم، اتهام الموظف بعد تقديم الاستقالة. هل يحق لجهة العمل مقاضاة موظف بعد استقالته وحصوله على إخلاء الطرف وتسليم ما كان في عهدته لزميل آخر حتى اكتُشف تلاعب بالأرصدة في عهدة الموظف المستقيل؟ حدث ذلك رغم تسليم العهدة بشكل سليم وقت الاستقالة
notes: post-resignation embezzlement allegation; asks whether an employer may sue after clearance and handover when stock/account irregularities are later discovered. General third-person wording does not identify the asker's role; no wage or labour-court process is specified.

text: هل يجب تصديق المستندات الصادرة من دولة أخرى قبل تقديمها للمحكمة؟. السلام عليكم، هل يجب تصديق الأوراق الرسمية الصادرة من خارج الدولة (أستراليا) قبل تقديمها باعتبارها مستندات ثبوتية في قضية قيد النظر لدى محكمة عجمان الشرعية؟ مستندات مثل عقد عمل وكشف حساب بنكي وفاتورة كهرباء. وما الجهة التي يجب أن تصدق على هذه المستندات؟ هل هي سفارة الإمارات في أستراليا؟
notes: foreign-document attestation for court evidence; asks who must authenticate Australian documents for an ongoing case at Ajman Sharia Court. A labour dispute is not established, so court_enforcement is not assumed merely because an employment contract is one exhibit.

text: هل هناك تبعات على إجراء عقد عمل صوري مع شركة قائمة بدون استلام راتب؟. السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، السادة الأعزاء المحترمين، في القانون الإماراتي وعلى الأراضي الإماراتية ما حكم العقد الصوري في هذه الحالة: مقيم عاطل عن العمل أعزب يبرم عقد صوري بمسمى وظيفي مزيف وراتب مرتفع جداً لكي يتمكن من كفالة أهله من الدرجة الأولى والثانية؟ هل يمكن غض الطرف عن هذه الفعلة؟ أم هل ستتم محاسبة هذا الشخص بسبب انتقاله المفاجئ من البطالة إلى الراتب المرتفع؟ وما النتائج المترتبة على اكتشاف العقد الصوري؟ هل سيتم إلغاء كفالة الأهل؟ هل سيتم تغريمهم؟ ترحيلهم؟ وماذا عن الشخص نفسه هل يمكن زجه في السجن؟ لا قدر الله أرجو الحصول على إجابة واضحة وشافية وشكراً لكم جزيل الشكر
notes: fictitious employment contract and family sponsorship; asks about consequences of a false job title and inflated salary used to sponsor relatives. The arrangement is hypothetical and the speaker's role is not stated. No actual unpaid-wage claim is made.

text: Is an unsigned contract with a forged signature still binding?. Hello, My contract is not signed by me; it is signed by someone else, and the signature does not match mine. My company does this. Is it still valid? I plan to resign, and my contract mentions a two-month prior notice. Am I required to give a two-month notice period if I did not agree to it in the contract? Is it possible to give a one-month notice period instead of two months?
notes: forged contract signature and notice period; employee disputes a two-month notice clause they did not sign and asks whether one month is possible. Two months is contractual notice, not service duration.

text: Does the employee compensate for visa costs upon resigning during probation?. Dear Sir/Madam, Does the employee have to compensate the employer for visa costs if they decide to resign during the probation period?
notes: Asks whether a resigning probationary employee must reimburse the employer's visa costs. General wording does not establish whether the speaker is worker or employer; no payment amount is given.

text: Can my employer charge me training fees even if I didn’t receive any certification?. Hello, The Second Party shall be obliged to pay back the value of the training (which is estimated at AED 10,000) if they terminate the employment contract of their own free will within one year from the date of commencement, without prejudice to the First Party's legal or contractual obligations. (The amount agreed upon for the value of the training period must be commensurate with the employee’s period of employment.) I have that clause in my labour contract regarding the training fees, but despite completing 359 days of service with the company, I have not received any such certification from them. Now, the company is refusing to cancel my employment and is demanding that I pay AED 10,000. In response, I filed a complaint with the Labour Department requesting the cancellation of my labour card. However, the process is being delayed, and meanwhile, the company has filed a counter-complaint against me, demanding the full AED 10,000. What can I do?
notes: training repayment; challenges a contractual training charge despite receiving no certification, with a labour complaint and employer counter-complaint pending. also: other (labour-card cancellation). Core question is liability for training costs, not court procedure; fees are not described as recruitment or visa costs. One year is the clause threshold; completed service is 359 days.

text: Do I have to pay my company after resignation for a training that never happened?. Hi Sir, I would like to ask a question. In my contract , there is an additional addendum stating that I have to pay up to 5000 AED for the training in case I terminate my contract within 1 year. Now the question is, I'm already 6 months in service. Do I have to pay that even though the company did not provide any training for me? I'm confused because it is stated you will have to pay because of the training but the company did not provide the training. Will I pay or not?
notes: training repayment; employer's addendum demands payment on departure before a year even though no training was provided. Charge is not identified as hiring or visa costs. One year is the penalty threshold, not completed service.

text: إصدار إقامة رغم وجود دعوى عمالية غير منتهية. السلام عليكم، رفعت دعوى عمالية بوزارة الموارد البشرية وقد أحالتها لمركز العضيد. تصل لي رسائل بشأنها ولم أحضر أي جلسة. بعد فترة أخذت مستحقاتي ووقعت على ورقة تنازل لصاحب العمل أنني أخذت مستحقاتي وهو لم يسألني عن شيء. لم أراجع المحكمة أيضًا. أستصدر حاليًا إقامة جديدة وإذا بالطلب مُعلّق! مع العلم أنني لم أحضر أي جلسة. ماذا أفعل لأكمل إجراءات الإقامة؟
notes: visa blocked by unresolved labour proceedings; worker received dues and signed a waiver but did not attend hearings or close the case. Asks how to resolve the still-pending case so new residence processing can proceed.

text: After the Dubai labor court verdict, how long one must wait to get money from the company?. After the Dubai labor court verdict how long one must wait to get money from the company? I have not heard anything after the verdict from my lawyer neither the company nor the government. Should I keep quiet on the assurance from the lawyer with only two words? Nothing yet. How long does an employer hold the payment from the Dubai Courts? Is there any time limit? If not, the court and I are both waiting for my employer's action
notes: Has a Dubai labour-court verdict but no payment and asks about collection deadlines and further steps. Employment duration, award amount and judgment date are not stated.

text: المطالبة بالمستحقات العمالية لدى توبيخ العامل وفصله. السلام عليكم، أعمل في الإمارات. التأشيرة علي شركة في دبي ولكن تم إعارتي لشركة في الشارقة. قام صاحب العمل بتوبيخي أمام زملائي وفصلني من العمل. عملت معهم منذ شهر يوليو من العام الماضي ولم يوفر صاحب العمل لي تأمينًا صحيًا ولا أوقات راحة خلال اليوم. ماذا أفعل؟
notes: Dismissed after being reprimanded in front of colleagues; asks about employment dues and next steps. also: other (health insurance, rest breaks and secondment). Visa sponsor is in Dubai and work was in Sharjah. Start month is relative to an unstated year, so no duration is calculated.

text: Our company is deducting visa payments. Is it lawful?. Hello, Our company is deducting visa payments. Is it lawful?
notes: Company deducts visa payments; asks if the deductions are lawful. also: unpaid_wages (salary-deduction mechanism). Worker perspective is inferred from the complaint about deductions by 'Our company'; no amount is stated.

text: What are the procedures to terminate an employee beside giving a 3 months' notice?. For terminating an employee by giving 3 months' notice, what is the best reason to write to be able to avoid any claim of arbitrary termination?
notes: Employer asks what reason to give for dismissal with three months' notice to avoid an arbitrary-termination claim. Preventive employer-side dismissal question; no completed dismissal or worker service duration is stated.

text: هل يلزم دفع مبلغ تأمين عند تسجيل استئناف عمالي؟. السلام عليكم، قضية عمالية جزئية مبلغ المطالبة فيها 70.000 درهم وتم عمل استئناف من جانب العامل. هل عند تسجيل استئناف عمالي يكون هناك مبلغ 1000 درهم تأمين أم لا؟ حيث أن المبلغ المُطالَب به هو 70000 درهم؛ وهو مبلغ أعلى من النصاب الانتهائي للمحكمة
notes: Asks whether a labour appeal requires a 1000 درهم security deposit when the claim is 70.000 درهم, also repeated as 70000 درهم. Appeal was lodged by the worker, but the speaker could be the worker or a representative; role is not explicit. Deposit is a court cost, not recruitment fees.

text: Do I have to pay a penalty if terminated after completing my contract period?. Sir, As per my contract period, they mentioned that if I leave the company before 1 year, I have to pay 5000 dirhams. But I have already completed more than 1 year and 3 months. The company has given me a warning letter saying my work performance is low, and if I continue like this, they will terminate me. They didn't mention any charges, but they mentioned in the letter a top penalty procedure. So I need to know whether I have to pay them any charges or not
notes: contractual exit penalty; asks whether a charge for departure before one year can apply after longer service and threatened performance-based dismissal. Penalty purpose is unspecified and no charge has yet been demanded. No completed dismissal or allegation that its reason is false is established.

text: Do I need to pay my company any compensation if I resign during probation?. I worked for a company and due to the lack of work-life balance affecting my mental and physical health, I submitted my resignation according to the contract I signed. The contract stipulated a two-month notice period during my probation as I joined this company on 05 Dec 2023. I submitted my resignation on March 20 stating my last working day as May 20 But the company released me on April 16. However, for the month of March, I did not receive my salary. Now the company is asking me to sign the visa cancellation letter In this letter there is a clause stating "I certify that I have received all my dues up to date - Employee signature" but I have not received my salary. I also explicitly asked them whether they would deduct any amount for the visas as some people have told me that some companies do such things even when nothing is mentioned in the contract. They replied to that email stating they would provide dues but did not mention any specific date. Please advise me on how to proceed
notes: March salary is unpaid and the employer requests a visa-cancellation signature acknowledging receipt of all dues. also: recruitment_fees (possible visa deductions, not yet confirmed); also: other (early release during notice). Joined 05 Dec 2023, resigned March 20, proposed May 20 as last day and was released April 16. Later dates have no explicit year; service duration is not calculated.

text: Can my company terminate me for redudancy then post the same on a website for jobs?. My company terminated me as redundancy due to reducing the workforce in UAE and after 1.5 months, they posted the same job on the jobs website
notes: Challenges a redundancy dismissal because the same vacancy was advertised 1.5 months later. The 1.5 months is the interval after dismissal, not length of employment.

text: Can I resign after completing probation period if the employer mentioned a wrong salary in the labor contract?. Can I resign after completing the probation period? The employer mentioned a wrong salary in the labor contract and a 3-month notice period. Need advice
notes: resignation, contract salary mismatch and notice period; asks about leaving after probation despite a wrong salary entry and three-month notice clause. No actual wage underpayment is stated; probation completion does not give a numeric service duration.

text: استئناف حكم عمالي بمثابة الحضوري بزعم عدم استلام الحكم الابتدائي. السلام عليكم، لدي قضية عمالية حُكم فيها بمثابة الحضوري في 13/04/2022، ومن ثَم أعلنت الخصم بموجب طلب قدمته للمحكمة، وبعد الإعلان تم عمل صيغة تنفيذية والإعلان للمرة الثانية بالتنفيذ في 03/08/2022. تقدّم الخصم بتسجيل دعوى استئناف على الحكم الابتدائي بزعم عدم استلام الحكم الابتدائي بالرغم من أن الإعلان كان بنفس طريقة إعلانه بالصيغة التنفيذية. رجاء الإفادة عن مدى قانونية دعوى الاستئناف!
notes: Challenges the legality of the opposing party's appeal based on alleged non-service of the first judgment. Judgment was on 13/04/2022 and execution notice on 03/08/2022; question concerns service and appeal procedure.

text: تنفيذ حكم عمالي على الشركاء حسب حصصهم في رأس المال. السلام عليكم، لدي ملف تنفيذ عمالي. هل أستطيع التنفيذ على حصة الشركاء في رأسمال الشركة وإلزامهم بسداد المديونية حسب حصصهم؟
notes: Existing labour execution file; asks whether recovery may be made against partners' capital shares and each partner's portion of the debt. No award amount or company name is stated.

text: Does the employee get gratuity and leave pay if the notice period is waived?. Hello, After the agreement between both employee and employer for no need of the 1-month notice after resignation, can I still get my gratuity and annual leave pay?
notes: Asks whether gratuity remains payable when both sides waive one month's resignation notice. also: other (annual leave pay). Gratuity is mentioned first; no actual refusal to pay has yet been alleged.

text: صاحب العمل يطالب بدفع تكاليف التدريب. هل هذا قانوني؟. السلام عليكم، أعمل في القطاع الخاص بعقد عمل سنوي محدد المدة (عقد داخلي ودوام جزئي). قدمت استقالتي قبل انتهاء العقد بشهر وذكرت في رسالة الاستقالة أنني سأدفع بدل فترة الإخطار. صاحب العمل أخبرني أنه يجب عليّ دفع مبلغ 5 آلاف درهم كلفة تدريب وقد وقعت على ذلك في العقد وأنا أظن ذلك، لكنني في الواقع لم أتلقَّ أيَّ تدريب من جهة ثالثة، فقد علمني الشخص السابق في مكاني بشأن العمل فقط. لذلك هل يحق له فعل ذلك؟ وإن لم أدفع المبلغ له، فماذا يمكنه أن يفعل؟ شكرًا لك!
notes: training repayment; resigned a month before a fixed-term annual part-time contract ended and offered notice pay, but employer also demands a training charge. Only handover instruction from the predecessor is described. The annual contract term is not confirmed completed service; fee is not stated to be recruitment costs.

text: كيفية تنفيذ حكم عمالي ضد شركة ليس لها أموال أو ممتلكات. لدي حكم استئناف عمالي منذ ٥ أشهر ولا تزال الشركة لا تدفع وتتعلل بالإفلاس، ورغم ذلك تجدد الرخصة التجارية وتتلاعب باستلام أموالها لدى الغير عن طريق حسابات وسيطة. أخيرًا طلبت من العملاء التعاقُد مع شركة من طرفها لتقوم بمهامها واستلام الأموال ليبدو الأمر قانونيًا. تم تقديم طلب ضبط وإحضار لأحد الشريكين "المدير المسئول"، ولكن المحكمة استبدلت الطلب بالحجز على الأموال والممتلكات التي لم تعد موجودة. مع العلم أن أول حكم للتنفيذ كان حجز الأموال والممتلكات! هل يمكن تقديم طلب بالحجز على أموال المدير الشريك؟
notes: Seeks to attach a manager-partner's assets after an unpaid labour appeal judgment and failed company-asset recovery. Claims company receipts were diverted through intermediaries and a related business. Five months is time since judgment, not employment duration.

text: Can I exit the UAE without canceling my company entry permit?. Hello, I came to Dubai on a company's entry permit. I have not completed any medical process yet, but I am not interested in that job. Can I leave the UAE without canceling the entry permit?
notes: entry-permit cancellation and departure; prospective employee has entered Dubai but completed no medical processing and wants to leave the UAE. No recruitment charge, passport retention or unpaid wage is alleged.

text: تهديد العامل وإجباره على إنهاء الخدمة. السلام عليكم، أعمل في فندق حكومي. لم أستلم رواتب أول ستة أشهر من العمل. تعرضت لضغوطات كثيرة من طرف المدير؛ مثل: العمل لساعات إضافية مجانًا، وتغيير موقع العمل كل يومين، وإعطائي عقوبة الجلوس في البيت بدون أي مبرر لمدة شهر مع العلم أنني الوحيد الذي يتعاملون معه بهذه الطريقة. عندما تكلمت عن حقي مع المدير، أحضروا ورقة إنهاء الخدمة ويجبرونني على توقيعها يوميًا ويحاولون منعي من دخول الفندق، وكذلك إخافتي وتهديدي بإحضار دورية الشرطة في المرة الأولى ورجل مباحث الفنادق التابع لشرطة أبوظبي في المرة الثانية والذين هم أصدقاء المدير. مع العلم أنه عند محاولتي فتح تطبيقات مثل تطبيق ICA أو MOHRE أو UAE Smart ID، أتفاجأ أن رقم هاتف الفندق أو مندوب الفندق هو المُسجّل في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بي في الجوازات. أطلب مساعدتكم لإرشادي. ماذا أفعل لأنني مقهور أقسم بالله؟
notes: Main narrative concerns coercion to sign termination papers, exclusion from the workplace and threats after asserting rights. also: unpaid_wages (first six months and unpaid overtime); also: other (immigration contact data and bullying). Reports employment at a government hotel, but legal coverage is not established. Six unpaid months do not prove total service duration.

text: After 11 months of work, how many leave days is an employee entitled to?. Hello, I want to inquire regarding my leave privileges. I am now 11 months in my company. How many leaves am I privileged to? Based on Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 regulating labour relations and its executive regulations, you are entitled to a paid weekly rest for not less than one day, as specified in the work contract or the work regulation. The Council of Ministers may increase the weekly rest day stipulated in this article. The Decree-Law and its executive regulations also stipulate that you are entitled to an annual leave with full pay as follows: - Thirty days for each year of your extended service. - Two days per month in respect of any employee with more than six months and less than one year of service. - Leave for parts of the last year of your service in case it is terminated before you use your annual leave balance. Now my question is: do I have 22 days I can use? Can someone explain to me in detail? Thank you!
notes: annual leave entitlement; asks whether 11 months of service allows 22 days of leave. Embedded legal-answer text is not used to determine eligibility or treated as verified law; label comes from the worker's question alone. No wage non-payment claim.

text: How can I renew my partner visa if the license of my company has expired two years ago?. My friend and I are using a partner visa. Due to some needs, the business didn't continue. He was in Abu Dhabi while I was in Dubai. Without telling me, he left UAE in August this year and our license has not been renewed for the past two years. It has expired and my visa has expired too. What do I do to cancel my visa and get an employment visa?
notes: partner-visa cancellation and move to employment visa after the business ceased and its licence expired. Speaker is a company partner, not clearly an employee or someone asking about an employee. Two years refers to the unrenewed licence, not service; departure month has no stated year.

text: Can a registered company work with a freelancer who does not have a freelancer permit?. Hello, Can a registered company work with a freelancer who does not have a freelancer permit? At the same time, they are employed by another company
notes: freelance work authorisation and secondary employment; asks whether a company can engage someone without a freelance permit who already works elsewhere. Company-side phrasing suggests a hiring concern, but the speaker's own role is not explicit.

text: تعديل الدعوى العمالية ومنع صاحب العمل من استخدام توقيع الموظف المفصول. السلام عليكم، فُصلت من العمل وطالبت ببدل فصل تعسفي لأنه لا يوجد سبب مقنع بالفصل ولكن عند تقديم الشكوى لم أذكر جميع مستحقاتي ( نهاية الخدمة والسكن وغيره) وذكرت فقط الفصل التعسفي وبعض الخصومات الأخرى. هل أستطيع المطالبة بالمستحقات الأخرى علمًا بأن الشكوى حُولت للقضاء وعلي متابعة القضية الآن؟
notes: Existing unfair-dismissal complaint has been referred to court; asks to add omitted gratuity, accommodation and other dues. also: unfair_termination; also: gratuity. Main issue is amending the claim. Title mentions use of a signature, but body provides no facts about it.

text: My receivable commission has been delayed by the company. How can I claim it?. Hi Team, I would like to ask. I'm an agent in the UAE, and my receivable commission has been delayed by my agency which is above AED 1 million. However the company is not running well lately, and it has a risk of insolvency. If it really happens, who should I claim my commission from? If there are still commissions not paid by the developer to the company, can I claim that part from the developer directly? Many thanks
notes: Agent seeks unpaid earned commission and asks who would pay if the agency becomes insolvent, including whether recovery from the developer is possible. Commission is treated as employment remuneration under wages/allowances; whether the agent is an employee or independent contractor is not explicit and may affect this label. No existing judgment is stated.

text: Can my employer extend my notice period without my consent?. Hello, I am serving my notice period with my current employer, and the day after it ends, I am supposed to join the new company. However, my current employer is telling me they will extend the notice period due to pending work. The reason I'm resigning is that I have to work 12-14 hours a day on a 9-hour shift, and there has also been mistreatment from the supervisor. Can they extend my notice period without my approval?
notes: notice-period extension without consent; worker is due to join a new employer immediately after notice ends. Reports 12-14-hour workdays against a nine-hour shift and supervisor mistreatment, but does not explicitly allege unpaid overtime.

text: تأخير الرواتب لأكثر من 6 أشهر والمطالبة بإلغاء الإقامة. السلام عليكم، لي رواتب متأخرة بالشركة لأكثر من 6 أشهر وانتهى عقد عملي وصاحب العمل يماطل في تسليم رواتبي المتأخرة ومستحقات نهاية الخدمة حتى انتهت إقامتي. أصبحت مخالفًا. هل أستطيع تقديم شكوى في مكتب العمل والتقدُّم بطلب لإلغاء إقامتي؟
notes: Wages have been unpaid for over six months after contract end, with residence expiry while the employer delayed settlement. also: gratuity; also: other (residence cancellation and overstay). Asks about filing a complaint; no existing judgment or court process is stated. Six months is arrears duration, not total service.

text: تجميد البنك لمكافأة نهاية الخدمة عند فقدان العمل. السلام عليكم أعمل في شركة قطاع خاص في دبي وقد قمت مؤخراً بالانضمام لشركة أخرى في أبوظبي براتب أعلى. سمعت الكثير من القصص عن أنَّ من حق البنك خصم مكافأة نهاية الخدمة الخاصة بي من الشركة القديمة لصالح القرض الذي أنا مديون له به. وسؤالي، هل هذا الإجراء قانوني؟ أليس الاتفاق مع البنك هو أن يحصل على الدين على دفعات شهرية منتظمة؟
notes: bank set-off against gratuity; asks whether the bank may deduct end-of-service funds toward a loan despite regular instalments. Employer non-payment and the amount of gratuity owed are not at issue, so this is classified as banking rather than gratuity. The question describes a concern based on stories, not a confirmed deduction.
